description:
Tier 2, late. A baseline (non-progressive) JPEG decoder is Huffman decoding of DC/AC coefficients, dequantisation, an 8x8 integer IDCT, and YCbCr upsampling: about a thousand lines of C in stb_image, all loops over bytes and integers. libjpeg-turbo is SIMD-tuned, so the speed verdict is expected poor; the entry exists for the safety story (JPEG parsers are a classic CVE source) and for Nerves/embedded where libvips is absent. Progressive JPEG raises.

Reuse the inflate ticket's bit reader and Huffman table builders. Output raw RGB [u8] plus width, height. Vectors: decode a corpus with libjpeg (via vix) and compare pixel-exact against the kernel (both use the same integer IDCT? No: libjpeg's IDCT variants differ; compare against stb_image's integer IDCT output, or allow +-1 per channel and document it).

Blocked by the inflate ticket, defk-6ag (code size), defk-ivt (zigzag and IDCT constants).

Done when: a corpus decodes with the agreed tolerance, fuzz agreement runs without a VM crash, the verdict is recorded even if poor.
title: Baseline JPEG decode from scratch (after inflate; untrusted-input decoder)
